title: 1625. Lexicographically Smallest String After Applying Operations

examples.explanation: We can apply the following operations: Start:  "5525" Rotate: "2555" Add:    "2454" Add:    "2353" Rotate: "5323" Add:    "5222" Add:    "5121" Rotate: "2151" Add:    "2050" There is no way to obtain a string that is lexicographically smaller than "2050".
We can apply the following operations: Start:  "74" Rotate: "47" Add:    "42" Rotate: "24" There is no way to obtain a string that is lexicographically smaller than "24".
There are no sequence of operations that will give us a lexicographically smaller string than "0011".
